question: Does a source-bound 1827 first-edition Airijinglu physical print directly attest 孫逢古, and does its bounded Zhunzhai entry already contain the 1887 same-entry body phrase 由此逢吉以心法創茲小壺?
answer: YES FOR THE 1827 FENGGU HEADER; NO OBSERVATION OF THE 1887 FENGJI BODY PHRASE ON THE COMPLETE BOUNDED 1827 P50-P51 ZHUNZHAI ENTRY SURFACE. NLC SET NLC892-001947627 V1 P5 DIRECTLY DATES THE EDITION TO 道光七年歲在丁亥秋九月. V5 P48 DIRECTLY OPENS 卷二十三 / 子部 / 天文算法類. V5 P50 DIRECTLY READS 準齋心製几漏圖式一卷 / 抄本 / 宋孫逢古撰 / 文淵閣書目著錄 / 從吳門黃氏藏舊抄本影寫. P51 DIRECTLY TRANSITIONS TO THE NEXT TITLE 大宋寶祐四年丙辰歲會天萬年具注曆一卷. THE 1887 BODY SENTENCE MUST NOT BE BACK-PROJECTED INTO 1827. RECENSION DIFFERENCE IS CLOSED; DIRECTION AND EXACT MUTATION EVENT REMAIN UNRESOLVED.
